rounds.text: The bear case rests on persistent operational mediocrity and severe stock volatility that undermine the bull thesis. The company generates a low return on equity, registering 6.6% to 8.6% across recent metrics [E12, E13], with a 3-year median ROE anchored at a depressed 7% [E28, E59] and a 10-year median also capped at 8% [E26]. Profit growth has stalled dramatically, showing a meagre 1% compounded increase over 3 years [E20] alongside decelerating earnings momentum and a net profit decline year-over-year [E66, E67]. Furthermore, the equity demands extreme price turbulence from investors, evidenced by an annualized volatility of 54.6% [E53], a twelve-month price return of -4.9% [E51], and a catastrophic historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -77.3% [E52]. Shareholder returns are further handicapped by an unappealing dividend payout averaging just 2.59% of profits over the last 3 years [E60] and a meager 0.26% dividend yield [E4]. Conceded: [E44] indicates a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of Rs 734 per share with a 48.7% margin of safety, and [E35] shows robust operating cash flow of Rs 83 Cr in Mar 2026.
